name: MiniMax
look: Stark monochrome broken open by saturated gradient cards, one vibrant colour per product line, pills everywhere.

hero.title: One platform, four model lines
hero.sub: Text, music, video and speech — each with its own frontier model, one API key, and pricing you can read on a single page.

features.title: Four models, four jobs
features.sub: Each line is trained for one modality rather than bolted onto a text model as an afterthought.

items.title: Vantage Text
items.body: A one-million-token context window that holds a whole codebase or a year of transcripts without chunking.

items.title: Vantage Music
items.body: Full arrangements from a text brief, stems delivered separately.

items.title: Vantage Video
items.body: Six seconds at 1080p from a prompt or a still, with camera motion you specify.

items.title: Vantage Speech
items.body: Forty-two languages with cloning from thirty seconds.

items.title: Tool calling
items.body: Structured output and function calls across every line.

items.title: One price page
items.body: Per-token, per-second and per-character rates, all published, no sales call required.

showcases.title: A million tokens, used properly
showcases.body: Long context is only useful if retrieval across it stays accurate. Vantage Text is evaluated on needle-in-haystack at full length, and the score is published at every depth rather than only the best one.

showcases.title: Priced without a conversation
showcases.body: Every rate is on one page — per token, per second of video, per character of speech. There is no enterprise tier that hides the number behind a form.

gallery.title: Playground
gallery.sub: Try every line in the browser before writing any code.

testimonial.quote: We replaced three vendors with one key. The part I did not expect was that the billing page finally made sense to our finance team.
testimonial.name: Wei Zhang

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: Pay per unit. Every rate on this page, no sales call.

items.a: It is evaluated at full depth and the per-depth scores are published, including the depths where accuracy dips. Nothing is silently truncated.

items.q: Can I use one key for all four lines?
items.a: Yes. One key, one billing account, one dashboard across text, music, video and speech.

items.q: What are the commercial terms on generated media?
items.a: You own the output on any paid tier, including commercial use. Free-tier output is watermarked and non-commercial.

items.q: Do you train on my inputs?
items.a: No. API inputs and outputs are excluded from training by default, with no setting to remember and no opt-out form to file.

cta.title: Start with $5 of credit
cta.sub: One key across all four lines. No card to begin.

footer.tagline: Four frontier model lines, one API key.

notes: A stark monochrome palette is broken open by saturated gradient cards. The monochrome is the default; the colour is the event.
Each product line owns a vibrant colour — coral for text, magenta for music, blue for video, orange for speech. Never mix them on one card.
Pills everywhere for buttons and tabs. Rectangles appear only inside data tables and dense documentation.
Hero type runs at 1.10 line-height with heavy negative tracking for impact.
Black promo banners above the nav are reserved for time-bound moments — they are not part of the standing chrome.
